name.description: Stable environment or map name; experiment folder names use the environment name.

width.description: Grid width in cells; must match the map width when terrain is supplied.

height.description: Grid height in cells; must match the map height when terrain is supplied.

rows.description: Equal-width strings of terrain symbols, one per map row.

elevation.description: Absolute tile elevation used for climbing differences and rendering.

blocked.description: Whether this terrain symbol contributes a blocking obstacle.

water_depth.description: Water depth at this tile; zero means dry land.

flow.description: Water-current vector [dx, dy] in grid cells per step; fractional drift is retained.

legend.description: Map symbol definitions for elevation, blocking, water depth and flow.

path.description: Path to archived champion metadata, not a replay or exact checkpoint file.

selection.description: Shared-library selection strategy for the requested champion metric.

metric.description: Champion ranking criterion to select from the requested library/archive context.

map_file.description: Path to a terrain map JSON; relative paths resolve from the current working directory first, then bundled/project assets.

terrain.description: Optional map geometry, either an inline terrain map or a map_file reference.

schema_version.description: Environment document schema version, not a package or checkpoint version.

name.description: Stable environment or map name; experiment folder names use the environment name.

description.description: Human-readable purpose of this preset; does not affect physics.

seed.description: Base seed for layout, controllers and reproducible run-seed generation; CLI overrides can replace it.

width.description: Grid width in cells; must match the map width when terrain is supplied.

height.description: Grid height in cells; must match the map height when terrain is supplied.

boundary.description: World boundary behavior; current worlds use closed edges.

max_steps.description: Maximum simulation steps per episode, not wall-clock seconds.

world.description: Grid dimensions, boundary rule and maximum episode duration.

generation.description: Choose scattered random obstacle generation or an explicit obstacle list.

occupied_fraction.description: Fraction of world cells selected as scattered obstacles.

explicit_cells.description: Obstacle coordinates as [x, y] pairs; used by explicit generation.

patch_count.description: Number of resource patches placed in free eligible cells.

capacity_per_patch.description: Maximum food quantity held by each patch.

initial_quantity_per_patch.description: Starting food quantity in each patch; cannot exceed capacity.

growth_per_step.description: Food quantity regenerated per patch per simulation step, capped by capacity.

resources.description: Shared food patch placement, capacity and regrowth.

swim_min_health.description: Minimum health required for active swimming under terrain rules.

swim_energy_cost.description: Additional energy effort for a swim action.

water_energy_cost.description: Additional energy charged for occupying water, scaled by depth.

drowning_damage.description: Depth-scaled health damage under the configured unsafe-water conditions.

uphill_energy_cost.description: Additional energy charged per positive elevation difference traversed.

max_climb.description: Maximum permitted positive elevation change for ordinary movement.

locomotion.description: Optional swimming, water exposure and elevation movement rules.

color.description: Female/base species color as a six-digit hex string.

male_color.description: Male species color as a six-digit hex string; male body outlines remain a separate cue.

display.description: Optional stable species/sex colors for the viewer, separate from physics and brain signatures.

female.description: Override for this species' female initialization or champion-selection group.

male.description: Override for this species' male initialization or champion-selection group.

initial_brains.description: Optional female and male initial champion selectors resolved independently.

female.description: Override for this species' female initialization or champion-selection group.

male.description: Override for this species' male initialization or champion-selection group.

champion_selection_by_sex.description: Female/male champion criterion overrides within this exact species.

path.description: Path to archived champion metadata, not a replay or exact checkpoint file.

selection.description: Shared-library selection strategy for the requested champion metric.

metric.description: Champion ranking criterion to select from the requested library/archive context.

initial_brain.description: Species-wide champion selector used when a sex-specific initializer does not override it.

initial_population.description: Number of founder animals of this species.

diet.description: Resource-eating animals consume food patches; prey-eating animals hunt resource-eating animals across species.

allowed_actions.description: Ordered action names available to this species; order is part of saved-model compatibility.

initial_energy.description: Energy granted to a founder or newborn of this species.

max_energy.description: Upper bound on stored animal energy.

max_health.description: Initial health and health cap; current reproduction eligibility uses absolute health units.

living_cost.description: Energy charged each step regardless of selected action, before circadian scaling.

movement_cost.description: Additional energy charged for movement actions, before circadian scaling and geography surcharges.

starvation_damage.description: Health lost per step while energy is exhausted.

vision_radius.description: Base radial sight distance in grid cells before optional sunlight and water modifiers.

bite_size.description: Maximum food units consumed by one successful eat action.

energy_per_food_unit.description: Energy granted per consumed food unit, subject to the animal energy cap.

water_vision_bonus.description: Maximum additional sight cells permitted along open-water rays.

field_of_view_degrees.description: Visual angular field around heading: 150 is a narrower forward sector, 180 is the front half-plane including sides, and 360 retains circular sight. Applies to targets, mates and witnessed outcomes, not scent or physical action eligibility.

brain.description: Key of the brain template used to initialize this species; each animal receives independent live state.

survival_steps_per_kill.description: Age normalization for the survival bonus in balanced predator selection.

max_survival_bonus.description: Maximum survival bonus added to kills by balanced predator scoring.

lineage_min_age_steps.description: Lineage maturity gate; defaults to reproduction.min_age_steps (at least one step).

champion_selection.description: Default criterion and scoring parameters used to curate this species' champions.

learning_rate_multiplier.description: Multiply the selected template learning rate for this species.

per_energy_gained.description: Reward per actual energy unit gained from feeding/hunting.

per_energy_cost.description: Reward coefficient on charged energy demand; normally negative to penalize effort.

failed_action.description: Additional reward/penalty when an attempted action fails.

per_offspring.description: Reward credited to a successful parent for producing offspring.

per_damage_taken.description: Reward coefficient per health damage received; normally negative.

death.description: Terminal reward/penalty when the animal dies.

per_damage_dealt.description: Optional reward per actual damage point credited to this attacker; omitted means zero.

rewards.description: Coefficients converting physical events, energy costs and failed choices into learning feedback.

enabled.description: Enable the containing optional feature; meaning and required companion fields depend on that feature.

probability_per_birth.description: Probability of attempting a mutation on an individual newborn.

max_changed_weights.description: Maximum distinct eligible matrix weights selected in a successful mutation event.

noise_std.description: Standard deviation of additive Gaussian mutation noise.

mutation.description: Rare newborn-only weight perturbation settings; does not mutate the whole species.

enabled.description: Enable the containing optional feature; meaning and required companion fields depend on that feature.

mate_radius.description: Proximal mate distance in cells, combined with same-species, physical-route and birth-space checks.

intent_steps.description: Consent duration including the reproduce step. Rest preserves intent; other actions cancel it. Default 1 retains same-step consent.

health_threshold.description: Each parent's health must be strictly above this absolute value to reproduce.

min_age_steps.description: Central age in steps at which an animal can first become eligible to reproduce.

cooldown_steps.description: Central number of age steps required between successful reproductions.

age_deviation_pct.description: First-maturity window half-width as a percentage of min_age_steps; takes precedence over legacy absolute deviation.

age_deviation_steps.description: Legacy first-maturity window half-width in absolute steps; prefer age_deviation_pct.

cooldown_deviation_pct.description: Cooldown window half-width as a percentage of cooldown_steps; takes precedence over legacy absolute deviation.

cooldown_deviation_steps.description: Legacy cooldown window half-width in absolute steps; prefer cooldown_deviation_pct.

min_energy.description: Minimum current energy required from each eligible parent.

energy_cost.description: Energy charged to each successful parent at reproduction; not a full health reset.

max_population.description: Living population cap for this exact species; includes founders and children.

reproduction.description: Same-species opposite-sex eligibility, consent window, maturity, cost and population limits.

night_vision_radius_multiplier.description: Night-time base sight multiplier; blends toward one at midday, then rounds to a valid grid radius.

night_living_cost_multiplier.description: Night-time living-cost multiplier; blends toward one with sunlight.

night_movement_cost_multiplier.description: Night-time movement-cost multiplier; blends toward one with sunlight.

circadian.description: Species-specific night multipliers, used only when the world day_night cycle is enabled.

competition.description: Optional same-species challenge contests for shared food and occupied paths; disabled unless enabled explicitly.

enabled.description: Enable physical contests initiated through the challenge action.

damage.description: Health damage dealt to the losing same-species animal; no hunting kill credit or kill energy.

energy_cost.description: Energy demand for each explicit challenge attempt, including unavailable or losing attempts.

food.description: Permit contests over the same reachable food patch when the opponent chooses eat or challenge; the winner receives the first normal bite.

blocked_path.description: Permit challenges against a same-species blocker ahead; a winning challenger advances only if a valid free retreat exists or the blocker dies.

aggression.description: Allow a learned challenge against a cardinally adjacent same-species animal without a food or path objective. Aggression deals damage but grants no feeding or movement priority.

spawn.description: Optional placement of founders only; saved positions and newborn placement are unchanged. Adjacent pairing requires an even initial population.

mode.description: Random retains the original seeded placement. Adjacent pairs place same-species opposite-sex founders on neighboring dry cells, respecting spawn zones and walkable slopes. Fails if insufficient disjoint adjacent cells exist.

species.description: Named species definitions at the root, species spawn-zone assignments under placement, or monitored species names under early_stopping; keys/names must match the environment.

type.description: Algorithm identifier for a brain, or architecture identifier inside network; allowed values depend on the object.

observation_version.description: Observation layout: 1 legacy, 2 terrain, 3 mating, 4 consent, 5 forward/right spatial coordinates and attack/eat/swim opportunity inputs. Older layouts retain their semantics; changing versions requires compatible fresh weights. Version 6 encodes V5 cues as soft categories, retains exact flags and requires compatible fresh weights. Version 7 uses compact numeric cues, summarized personal movement, four-value scent bearings and configured-action consequence rows; earlier versions remain supported.

hidden_layers.description: Hidden processing-layer widths in order; location differs between legacy Q-network and network-based templates.

learning_rate.description: Base optimizer update rate before the species multiplier.

discount_factor.description: Future-reward discount gamma, applied per simulation transition.

batch_size.description: Samples per optimizer batch; exact interpretation depends on replay or rollout algorithm.

replay_capacity.description: Maximum stored experience transitions for replay-based learners.

learning_starts_after.description: Minimum collected experiences before replay-based optimization begins.

train_every_steps.description: Decision-step interval between replay updates or GRPO trial requests, depending on algorithm.

decay_per_decision.description: Multiplicative epsilon decay per decision, bounded by minimum.

exploration.description: Epsilon-greedy action-exploration schedule for value-based learners.

observation_top_k.description: Maximum visible target slots per food/prey/predator category; unused slots are zero-filled.

movement_history_steps.description: Previous simulation steps of personal top-k animal sightings to retain. Zero disables the appended movement block; unseen positions are never backfilled and last-seen confidence fades over this window.

items.description: Exact configured species name to sense.

species.description: Sensed species in input-channel order; all names must exist in the environment.

radius.description: Automatic ground-scent sampling range in orthogonal dry-cell path steps; blocked or wet cells stop propagation.

separate_sexes.description: Use female then male channels per species; false merges both sexes into one anonymous channel.

mode.description: Separated preserves legacy species/sex channels. Blended combines all configured species and sexes into one anonymous nine-sector field; do not specify species or separate_sexes in blended mode.

scent_observation.description: Optional automatic scent inputs: nine local sector strengths per separated group or one blended field for all animals. Requires scent_trails.enabled; omission disables this brain's scent inputs.

social_observation.description: Opt-in pooled recent visible same-species action/outcome summaries (24 additional inputs). No identities or exact rewards.

history_steps.description: Recent observed steps pooled for collective action/outcome rates; no hidden outcomes are backfilled.

max_neighbors.description: Maximum nearest visible same-species neighbors sampled per observer per step before aggregation.

consequence_observation.description: Append consequence knowledge inputs: 48 for context or species_action scope, 96 for both. Each action has confidence, harm, feeding and birth estimates. Requires consequence_learning.enabled.

consequence_scope.description: Consequence inputs: context provides 48 state-matched estimates (legacy); species_action provides 48 published same-species action estimates independent of state/mask; both concatenates 48 general then 48 context inputs, each with confidence, allowing learned neural relevance. Requires consequence_observation=true; participates in model compatibility.

soft_categories.description: V6 only: fixed-length, strictly increasing soft-category knots on normalized V5 values. Omitted groups use defaults. Endpoints remain fixed; values beyond the represented range saturate.

distance.description: Normalized distance membership centers; fixed endpoints 0.0 and 1.0.

energy.description: Normalized energy membership centers; fixed endpoints 0.0 and 1.0.

health.description: Normalized health membership centers; fixed endpoints 0.0 and 1.0.

level.description: Normalized level membership centers; fixed endpoints 0.0 and 1.0.

depth.description: Normalized depth membership centers; fixed endpoints 0.0 and 1.0.

elevation.description: Normalized elevation membership centers; fixed endpoints 0.0 and 1.0.

climb.description: Normalized climb membership centers; fixed endpoints -1.0 and 1.0.

speed.description: Normalized speed membership centers; fixed endpoints 0.0 and 1.4142135623730951.

outcome.description: Normalized outcome membership centers; fixed endpoints 0.0 and 1.0.

max_adjustment.description: Maximum absolute learned consequence residual added to each action logit.

late_consequence.description: Optional V7 PPO/masked-PPO private learned late logit adjustment. Published evidence bypasses the physical input trunk and stays frozen in each rollout sample.

gae_lambda.description: Lambda controlling the temporal bias/variance balance of generalized advantage estimates.

entropy_coefficient.description: Weight of the entropy term encouraging action diversity in the policy objective.

value_coefficient.description: Weight of the value-prediction loss for actor-critic methods.

rollout_steps.description: Collected transition count at which an on-policy rollout update is triggered.

batch_size.description: Samples per optimizer batch; exact interpretation depends on replay or rollout algorithm.

max_grad_norm.description: Global gradient-norm clipping threshold before optimizer updates.

normalize_advantages.description: Whether the supported learner normalizes its collected advantages.

observation_top_k.description: Maximum visible target slots per food/prey/predator category; unused slots are zero-filled.

movement_history_steps.description: Previous simulation steps of personal top-k animal sightings to retain. Zero disables the appended movement block; unseen positions are never backfilled and last-seen confidence fades over this window.

items.description: Exact configured species name to sense.

species.description: Sensed species in input-channel order; all names must exist in the environment.

radius.description: Automatic ground-scent sampling range in orthogonal dry-cell path steps; blocked or wet cells stop propagation.

separate_sexes.description: Use female then male channels per species; false merges both sexes into one anonymous channel.

mode.description: Separated preserves legacy species/sex channels. Blended combines all configured species and sexes into one anonymous nine-sector field; do not specify species or separate_sexes in blended mode.

scent_observation.description: Optional automatic scent inputs: nine local sector strengths per separated group or one blended field for all animals. Requires scent_trails.enabled; omission disables this brain's scent inputs.

value_epochs.description: Number of independent critic fitting epochs per TRPO rollout.

max_kl.description: Maximum empirical old-to-new categorical policy KL accepted by TRPO backtracking.

cg_iterations.description: Maximum conjugate-gradient iterations for the TRPO natural-gradient direction.

cg_damping.description: Positive diagonal damping added to the TRPO Fisher-vector product.

cg_tolerance.description: Squared residual tolerance for the TRPO conjugate-gradient solve.

backtrack_steps.description: Maximum tested fractions of the TRPO policy step.

backtrack_coefficient.description: Multiplicative step shrinkage between TRPO backtracking candidates.

accept_ratio.description: Minimum actual-to-predicted surrogate improvement ratio for a TRPO candidate.

social_observation.description: Opt-in pooled recent visible same-species action/outcome summaries (24 additional inputs). No identities or exact rewards.

history_steps.description: Recent observed steps pooled for collective action/outcome rates; no hidden outcomes are backfilled.

max_neighbors.description: Maximum nearest visible same-species neighbors sampled per observer per step before aggregation.

brains.description: Named controller templates; a template name is separate from its algorithm type.

runs.description: Maximum number of episodes in this experiment; early stopping may finish sooner.

chain_best_brains.description: Initialize later fresh episodes from matching retained champion groups when enabled.

retain_brains_between_runs.description: Legacy controller-retention compatibility flag; modern champion chaining is governed by chain_best_brains.

world_seed_policy.description: Choose random, fixed or incrementing world seeds across runs; CLI seed overrides are recorded.

record_metrics_every_steps.description: Simulation-step interval for readable training metric records; final metrics are forced.

checkpoint_every_runs.description: Completed-run interval for intermediate exact checkpoints in the CLI; final state is saved separately.

grpo_updates_per_step.description: Maximum GRPO animal trial updates scheduled in one real-world step.

guard_lineage_chaining.description: Retain the previous qualified matching-sex lineage brain when a new episode only provides an unqualified fallback.

promote_only_improved.description: Retain best-so-far species/sex/criterion champions; ties keep the incumbent.

patience_runs.description: Consecutive completed runs without a selected champion rank improvement; zero disables.

species.description: Configured species to monitor. Omit to watch all; any monitored sex/species improvement resets patience.

early_stopping.description: Optional consecutive-run stagnation limit and monitored species.

checkpoint_keep_last.description: Retain the latest N recovery checkpoints created by this invocation, including final; zero retains all. Existing artifacts are never pruned.

checkpoint_every_steps.description: Periodic full exact-resume checkpoint cadence within each run; zero disables. Run-end checkpoint cadence still applies.

brain_save_every_steps.description: Check best-so-far champions every K steps and persist only strict rank improvements with changed weights; zero disables periodic saves. Run-end archives remain unchanged.

brain_save_min_score_delta.description: Minimum absolute increase in the primary ranking coordinate since the last periodic save; strict lexicographic improvement and changed weights are also required. Uniform abstract score units; does not affect selection or run-end archives.

checkpoint_shared_metadata.description: Binary CLI checkpoints share immutable configuration, action order and signatures in checksummed run-local metadata blobs. Keep the _metadata directory with checkpoint files; false writes self-contained v3 files.

brain_keep_last.description: Retain N most recent qualifying improvement-only periodic best-brain milestones, not arbitrary timed snapshots. Zero retains all. Numbered end-of-run champion archives and all playback chunks remain untouched.

experiment.description: Run schedule, seeding, model chaining, metric cadence and checkpoint behavior.

enabled.description: Enable the containing optional feature; meaning and required companion fields depend on that feature.

frame_every_steps.description: World-step interval between recorded playback frames; sparse frames omit intermediate events.

frames_per_chunk.description: Maximum committed replay frames per independently loadable chunk.

encoding.description: Replay representation: legacy full snapshots, JSON deltas or structured binary according to allowed values.

compression.description: Replay transport compression; independent of the logical encoding.

compression_level.description: Compression effort level used for the selected replay compressor.

diagnostics_every_steps.description: Step interval for sampled brain inputs/outputs/activations, with chunk-start/final capture rules; zero disables all diagnostic capture.

record_activations.description: Include compact sampled hidden activations for actual-animal playback; does not add weights.

profile.description: Training recording preset: full preserves configured cadence, compact uses a diagnostic interval of at least 50 steps (plus chunk-start/final samples) and omits activations, training-only omits replay files. Evaluation/random use full configured recording; enabled=false still disables capture.

record_last_episodes.description: Record only the final K episodes of the configured schedule, capped at its total. -1 records all; 0 disables playback. Original episode numbers and per-episode frame cadence are preserved. Early stopping may end before the selected window; recording profiles/enabled=false can still disable capture.

recording.description: Optional replay cadence, chunk format/compression and sampled brain diagnostics.

enclosure_bounds.description: Rectangle [left, top, right, bottom] defining inside, outside and boundary zones.

species.description: Named species definitions at the root, species spawn-zone assignments under placement, or monitored species names under early_stopping; keys/names must match the environment.

boundary_fraction.description: Fraction of resource patches allocated near the enclosure boundary.

inside_fraction.description: Fraction of boundary-near resource patches placed on the inside.

boundary_width.description: Width in cells of the boundary-near resource band.

resources.description: Shared food patch placement, capacity and regrowth.

placement.description: Optional founder zones and boundary-biased resource placement for an enclosure.

enabled.description: Enable the containing optional feature; meaning and required companion fields depend on that feature.

cycle_steps.description: Number of world steps in a full simulated day, independent of playback speed.

start_phase.description: Initial cycle fraction: zero midnight, 0.25 sunrise, 0.5 midday, 0.75 sunset.

day_night.description: Optional repeating sunlight cycle; omitted or disabled leaves static body values and lighting.

enabled.description: Deposit anonymous species/sex ground traces. Omission or false disables scent storage and sensing.

lifetime_steps.description: Ground-trace lifetime in simulation steps; freshness decreases linearly to zero, and revisiting a cell refreshes its group trace.

scent_trails.description: Optional anonymous ground-scent field. Traces persist after their maker leaves or dies, merge per cell/species/sex, and do not cross water or sealed obstacles.

consequence_learning.description: Optional bounded species-level predictor of physical consequences, retained across episodes and recovery checkpoints. Individual policy parameters remain independent.

enabled.description: Enable training and persistent storage of consequence outcome frequencies; evaluation reads without training.

max_contexts.description: Maximum context records retained per participating species using deterministic update-order LRU eviction.

horizon_steps.description: Observed step window for harm, feeding and birth outcomes; death closes the window and episode truncation discards incomplete windows.

update_schedule.description: When collected outcome evidence becomes visible as consequence estimates: continuous updates immediately after closed windows; episode freezes the published model and publishes staged evidence before the next episode starts.

persistent_action_totals.description: Retain species/action outcome totals independently of bounded context eviction; publication follows update_schedule. Legacy imports bootstrap from available context counts.
